newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes higher and supports Brent.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes higher and supports Brent.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed firmer on Tuesday after falling away earlier in the day, and dragged Brent higher, dealers said.
Sept gas oil, which expires on Thursday, settled 75 cents a tonne firmer at $218.00.
Oct Brent, which expires on Friday, was 14 cents a barrel up at $22.75 at 1654 GMT after bouncing off earlier lows at $22.32.
"Brent was dragged down by gas oil and when that rallied, Brent came back up again," one dealer said, adding that good inland European demand for gas oil was supportive.
Another player said strength in U.S. markets, where Oct NYMEX crude oil broke upwards through Monday's high of $24.00 a barrel, had helped propel energy prices higher too.
He added that continuing military activity in northern Iraq was also underpinning prices, but he saw little fresh news on Tuesday afternoon.
